items.headline: Update: PM Wong says Singapore is identifying firms behind Indonesia fires and weighing prosecution
items.summary: PM Lawrence Wong said Singapore is pinpointing the companies behind Indonesian fires and will act under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act where warranted, exploring joint action with other countries.

items.headline: O-Level written exams may be rescheduled if the haze forecast enters the hazardous band
items.summary: Education Minister Desmond Lee said MOE and SEAB will consider rescheduling O-Level papers if the next day's PSI forecast hits the hazardous 301-plus band; schools would close on the same trigger.

items.headline: NEA distributes N95 masks to vulnerable Singaporeans through Community Clubs as haze persists
items.summary: The NEA began phased distribution of N95 masks via People's Association Community Clubs to seniors, CHAS cardholders, ComCare recipients, pregnant women and children as unhealthy air dragged on.

items.headline: Bodybuilder, 20, died after taking the banned weight-loss drug DNP, coroner rules
items.summary: State Coroner Adam Nakhoda ruled the death of a 20-year-old bodybuilder a substance-related accident after he took the banned weight-loss drug DNP; police found 34 types of medication in his home.

items.headline: Woman, 77, found dead on the PIE had earlier been hit in Jurong West, over 2km away
items.summary: A 77-year-old woman found dead on the Pan-Island Expressway had earlier been struck in Jurong West, more than 2km away; a 66-year-old minibus driver was arrested.

items.headline: Rupee pulled back from its record low but is seen sliding toward 100 to the dollar
items.summary: The rupee recovered from about 96.79 to the 95 level after RBI measures, but analysts expect it to weaken toward 97-98 by year-end; RBI interventions cut reserves by about US$51bn as of 2 October.

items.headline: Reliance's Jio Platforms IPO set to raise up to 302 billion rupees in India's biggest listing
items.summary: Reliance's Jio Platforms will raise up to 302 billion rupees (nearly US$3.2bn) in India's largest-ever IPO, at a valuation below earlier expectations amid a market slump.

items.headline: Modi under pressure as youth-led 'cockroach' protests reach a decade high
items.summary: SCMP reported the voter-roll protest movement has become the largest youth unrest of Modi's tenure, demanding the Election Commission chief resign; police detained movement figures on 16 October.

items.headline: Speculation over a securities transaction tax cut lifts sentiment for Indian stocks
items.summary: Indian equities drew support after Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman's remarks fuelled speculation about a possible securities transaction tax cut ahead of the February budget.

items.headline: Chancellor Healey set to raise the bank surcharge at the 28 October Budget, lenders warn of a growth hit
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey is expected to lift the bank surcharge at his 28 October Budget; UK Finance warned raising it to 8% from 3% would cut lending by about £10bn by 2029 and reduce output by roughly £6bn over five years.

items.headline: SNP's Swinney renews his push for a second independence referendum at the Aberdeen conference
items.summary: First Minister John Swinney used the SNP conference in Aberdeen to intensify demands for a second independence vote, rebuffing PM Andy Burnham's offer of deeper devolution.

items.headline: UK economy unexpectedly grew 0.1% in August as manufacturing offset weaker services
items.summary: Official data showed UK GDP rose 0.1% in August 2026, beating forecasts, with a manufacturing pickup offsetting softer services, construction and IT output, just ahead of the 28 October Budget.

items.headline: Former British Army chef jailed for nearly four years over terrorism-linked weapons offences
items.summary: Mark Broadhurst, 28, a former British Army chef, was sentenced at Sheffield Crown Court to almost four years after counter-terror officers found he had been ordering components to make explosives; a judge ruled the offences were connected to terrorism.

items.headline: Trump waives Russia sanctions days before they take effect, drawing bipartisan backlash
items.summary: President Trump signed an executive order waiving sanctions that would have imposed up to 100% tariffs on major buyers of Russian crude; senators from both parties objected, Zelensky warned it would embolden Moscow, and the EU readied a 22nd sanctions package.

items.headline: France sees nationwide protests, with about 550,000 marching and some 400 arrested
items.summary: Cost-of-living and education protests drew about 550,000 people across France on 17 October, including 110,000 in Paris, with at least 400 arrests and city halls stormed in Marseille and Lille.

items.headline: Pope Leo discharged from hospital four days after lung-cancer surgery
items.summary: Pope Leo XIV left hospital on 17 October, four days after lung-cancer surgery; doctors said there were no clinical reasons his planned November Latin America trip should not proceed.

items.headline: Venezuela's Maduro pleads not guilty to a US torture-conspiracy charge in New York
items.summary: Nicolas Maduro and wife Cilia Flores appeared in a Manhattan federal court on 15 October and rejected a newly unsealed conspiracy-to-commit-torture count added to drug-trafficking charges; trial was set for June 2027.

items.headline: Russia's overnight strikes kill at least eight across Ukraine as hundreds of drones are launched
items.summary: Ukraine's Air Force said Russia fired 332 drones and missiles overnight into 17 October, intercepting 293; at least eight people were killed and nearly 60 injured in strikes on energy infrastructure.

items.headline: Replit drops Anthropic and makes OpenAI its default model
items.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt, Replit's CEO said OpenAI's ChatGPT is now the platform's default model over Anthropic's Claude, citing cost; Claude remains selectable.

items.headline: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter model tuned to run on Macs
items.summary: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter model (42bn active) with a one-million-token context window, optimised to run locally on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios via Apple's MLX framework.

items.headline: Amazon debuts new Bee AI wearables from US$75 with a US$12 monthly plan
items.summary: Amazon launched two new Bee wearables, including a US$75 wristband with a seven-day battery that transcribes the wearer's day into recaps and to-do lists, alongside a US$12-a-month subscription.

items.headline: DeepSeek ships a V4.1-Flash update it says runs faster and leaner
items.summary: DeepSeek released an updated V4.1-Flash model across its web, app and developer platform, claiming better benchmarks with faster, shorter outputs; it follows September's V4.1 Flash.

items.headline: White House AI task force commissions a report on superintelligence risks
items.summary: At its first meeting, the Trump administration's AI task force, led by DNI Jay Clayton and FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson, agreed to address cybersecurity, biosecurity and model control, and will commission a risk report from PCAST.

items.headline: Big US bank stocks head for their worst weekly losing streak since the 2008 crisis
items.summary: After a mixed third-quarter reporting round, large-cap US bank shares were set for their longest run of weekly declines since the 2008 crisis, Bloomberg reported, amid worries over credit quality.

items.headline: Berkshire Hathaway rallies close to a record as the broader market sells off
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's Class A shares closed at US$798,000 on 16 October, just 1.4% below their all-time high, bucking the sell-off, helped by a quiet hurricane season and higher rates lifting cash income.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley's wealth arm pulls in a record US$232bn of net new assets
items.summary: Morgan Stanley reported third-quarter net revenue of US$20.3bn, up from US$18.2bn a year earlier, and US$3.03 diluted EPS, with its wealth unit drawing a record US$232bn in net new assets.

items.headline: Turkey faces losing its MSCI emerging-market status over a stock-fixing scandal
items.summary: MSCI threatened to revoke Turkey's emerging-market classification over a stock-fixing scandal that could freeze Turkish companies out of global indexes, and separately proposed downgrading Indonesia.

items.headline: 🎾 Davidovich Fokina stuns top seed Zverev to reach his first Shanghai Masters final
items.summary: Spain's Alejandro Davidovich Fokina beat world No. 1 Alexander Zverev 5-7, 6-4, 6-3 in the Shanghai Masters semi-final, reaching his second Masters 1000 final and first since Monte Carlo in 2022.

items.headline: 🎾 Jodar beats Medvedev to set up an all-Spanish Shanghai Masters final
items.summary: Twenty-year-old Rafael Jodar beat Daniil Medvedev 6-3, 6-4 to become the youngest finalist in Shanghai Masters history and reach his first Masters 1000 final, meeting compatriot Davidovich Fokina.

items.headline: 🏎️ Antonelli can clinch his maiden F1 title at next week's US Grand Prix in Austin
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli leads Mercedes team-mate George Russell by 102 points after finishing third in Singapore and can be crowned 2026 champion at the US Grand Prix (Austin, 23-25 October) under a narrow set of results.

items.headline: 🏎️ Russell to take a grid penalty at the Las Vegas GP for an upgraded Mercedes power unit
items.summary: George Russell said Mercedes plan for him to take a grid penalty at the Las Vegas Grand Prix (20-22 November) to fit an upgraded power-unit element; he trails Antonelli by 102 points with six rounds left.

items.headline: Bleached corals fully recover within eight weeks when touching a healthy neighbour
items.summary: In a lab study reported by Nature, bleached and healthy Pocillopora damicornis fragments fused into a bridge that let algal symbionts spread, fully restoring the bleached coral within eight weeks.

items.headline: Nearly half of reef-building corals face an elevated risk of extinction, a Red List reassessment finds
items.summary: A Nature study reassessing 892 reef-building coral species for the IUCN Red List classified about 340 of 774 species with sufficient data (roughly 44%) as threatened, mostly from projected heat stress.

items.headline: A Jurassic flightless bird found in China shows early birds were more diverse than thought
items.summary: A fossil bird named Yuezhuornis yangyuanensis from the Late Jurassic of southeastern China, published in Nature, had short forelimbs pointing to a flightless, terrestrial lifestyle alongside flying relatives in the age of Archaeopteryx.

items.headline: NASA's SpaceX Dragon docks at the ISS carrying the station's final roll-out solar arrays
items.summary: NASA's 35th SpaceX resupply mission docked at the ISS Harmony module, delivering the last pair of roll-out solar arrays for installation during spacewalks on 29 October and 5 November, plus new experiments.

items.headline: NASA's Perseverance rover sets an all-time off-world driving record on Mars
items.summary: NASA said Perseverance's odometer reached 28.10 miles (45.22km) on 11 October, passing Opportunity's 28.06-mile mark, covering the distance in about 5.5 years with AutoNav driving more than 90% of it.

fun_fact.headline: The University of Oxford is older than the Aztec Empire.
fun_fact.body: The University of Oxford is older than the Aztec Empire. There is evidence of teaching at Oxford as far back as 1096, and it grew rapidly into a true university after 1167 - whereas the Aztec Triple Alliance that formed the empire was founded only in 1428, and its capital Tenochtitlan was established in 1325.

puzzle.title: Table for Four
puzzle.body: Four colleagues - Ava, Dev, Sam and Mei - sit in seats 1-4 (left to right), each with a different drink: tea, coffee, juice or water. (1) Ava is at an end. (2) The coffee drinker sits immediately right of Dev. (3) Sam sits immediately left of Mei. (4) Juice is seat 1, water is seat 4. (5) Mei is not coffee; Dev is not juice.
puzzle.approach: Fix what is certain, then let the 'immediately right/left' clues force the rest.
puzzle.answer: Seat 1 Ava juice; Seat 2 Dev tea; Seat 3 Sam coffee; Seat 4 Mei water.

word_puzzle.title: Boxed In
word_puzzle.body: Letter Boxed. Sides - TOP: T N S; RIGHT: R G H; BOTTOM: I L O; LEFT: A E P. Consecutive letters must come from different sides; each new word starts with the previous word's last letter. Solve in two words using all twelve letters.
word_puzzle.approach: Find a long first word that drains most of the box.
